{"subject":"Checking in from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

It's been a while since we last caught up, and I've been meaning to check in on how things are going at Unit.

I'd love to hear what the team has been focused on lately and what's ahead. If it's useful, I'm happy to find 20 minutes for a quick call in the next few weeks, whenever suits your schedule.

Either way, rooting for you all.

Jordan"}
